script_text: Stop! Aries, the stars are not whispering; they are lighting the fuse under your chart. Mars, your ruling planet, is trining Saturn in your 1st House from the 5th House, sharpening your fire-sign courage into controlled action. This is the rare Mars-Saturn trine that rewards timing, not impulse. Saturn is also squaring Uranus in your 2nd House, while Neptune conjuncts Saturn, so money habits and self-image are being tested. With Venus conjunct the Sun in your 3rd House, a single Aries meets a clever, magnetic person through a short trip, message, or sibling circle; if taken, protect the 7th House from blunt words. In the 10th House of career, a delayed payment or contract detail lands in your favor after you correct one technical error. Avoid signing anything before rereading the fine print, because your gift is a sudden refund, bonus, or client yes. Follow for tomorrow's reading.
